title: Deboli (St Petersburg) to King Stanisław August, cipher despatches of 1791 (AGAD Zbiór Popielów 5; catalogue 420)

plaintext.source: ZbPop 421 item 088 (k. 297, 301) is the clear text of this date; it looks short for a 2,202-group despatch and is not yet checked.

transcription.notes: Closed q-like 4 vs 9 and the z-shaped 2/4 are the main doubts; 62 groups marked ? across 001-003. Small letters a/b/c (rarely e, z, o, oo) are written under many groups; meaning not yet known.

system.summary: A Polish syllabic code of about 2,200 numbered groups with whole-word groups for common words and titles, small a/b/c marks under many groups, and a clear French salutation and closing.

prior_solution.where: AGAD Zbiór Popielów 421: the cabinet's fair-copy decipherments, catalogued by AGAD as Deboli's clear Polish letters

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue 420 task brief; no other input.

solution.what: Parsed the AGAD ZbPop 5 letter list (105 items, 463 images) and found the full-size image path on agadd2.
Looked for the key units ZbPop 444, 451, 453, 454 and the deciphered registers 317/320 online: no album and no letter list.
Web search in Polish and English for decipherments of Deboli's 1791 cipher despatches; Zielińska & Danilczyk edit 1780-1782 only; Szczygielski 2014 cites only the King's clear letters.
The 'Sire!' salutation suggested French plaintext; the same-day ZbPop 421 despatch also opens 'Sire!' and continues in Polish.
Transcribed the 1792 Danzig mixed clear/code letters ZbPop 415 items 084 and 086 (794 groups) with their filed clear copies.
Transcribed ZbPop 5 despatches 001 and 002 in full and the first page of 003: 3,124 groups.
Compared the 1791 code with the 1792 Danzig code: the frequent Danzig groups do not occur in 1791, and 1791 has one-digit groups that Danzig lacks; different codes.
The ZbPop 421 'clear despatches' are the cabinet's decipherments of ZbPop 5: same despatch numbers, 'reçu le' docket, 103 date matches with tracking image counts.

Read ZbPop 421 item 090 and matched it to cipher 002: ani od WKrMci, ani od Deputacyi = 1944 951 1578 1944 951 21a 2152; przysięgi x2 = 1117 1353 212 1775; Graff(owi de) Stahremberg x2 = ... 686 1405 1255 207, at the expected positions.

outcome.method_basis: The cabinet's contemporary fair-copy decipherments survive as AGAD Zbiór Popielów 421 and match the cipher; the work left is transcribing and checking.

credits.note: the royal cabinet's fair-copy decipherments, AGAD Zbiór Popielów 421 (catalogued as Deboli's clear letters)

outcome.notes: In progress: 3 of 105 despatches transcribed, one aligned. The same cipher/clear pairing very probably holds for catalogue 417-421 (ZbPop 428/417, 17/419, 4/420, 416/415).
